content.answer_markdown:
This Recommendation proposes these Trade Lines to rebalance the Portfolio back to its Target Allocation by Asset Class. Currently, the Portfolio has a significant drift: bonds are underweight at 40.01% actual versus 65.0% target (a negative drift of 24.99 percentage points), and cash is overweight at 40.01% actual versus 15.0% target (a positive drift of 25.01 percentage points). Equity is close to target at 19.99% actual versus 20.0% target.

To correct this, the Recommendation includes:
- Selling SGOV (iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF), which is 25.01% of the Portfolio, to reduce the overweight cash exposure.
- Buying AGG (iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF), 15.62% of the Portfolio, to increase bond exposure towards the target.
- Buying SHY (iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF), 9.37% of the Portfolio, also to increase bond exposure.

This results in a turnover of 25.0% of the Portfolio, which is above the 15% threshold, indicating a significant rebalance. After these trades, the post-trade drift for bonds, cash, and equity is within tolerance, effectively bringing the Portfolio back to its target allocation. The Recommendation is rule-based and band-based, with no research tilt applied.
